title_en: UNIVERS CITY APARTMENT FOR SALE 1+1 LOAN OPTION
description_en: In the Univers City complex near QTU, we sell a 1+1 apartment with Certificate of Ownership! The apartment is located on the 6th floor (not the last), facing south-west. With an internal surface of 61 m2 and 70.5 m2 total. It is organized in: -Living room with kitchen -1 Bedroom -Toilet -Balcony The property has Ownership Certificates! The complex offers: green spaces and recreational areas, playgrounds for children, supermarkets, bars & restaurants, schools and educational institutions, public transport, parking in the complex.
